title: Detecting Unintended Social Bias in Toxic Language Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Training classification and generation models (BERT, GPT-2) on the curated ToxicBias dataset to predict bias presence and categories, and evaluating unintended model bias against gender identity terms using Subgroup, BPSN, and BNSP AUC metrics.
